meta.title: 在家学拉花第一课：如何萃取适合拉花的浓缩咖啡
meta.title_en: Home Latte Art Lesson 1: Pulling an Espresso for Latte Art
meta.topic: 咖啡 · 浓缩萃取教学

scenes.title_cn: 开场：目标只是适合拉花的浓缩
scenes.title_en: Opening: The Goal Is an Espresso for Latte Art
scenes.context: UP 主先划清边界：讨论的是家庭小白如何在家做出适合拉花的浓缩咖啡，好不好喝不在讨论范围。方法论分三步：选豆、设备、参数。
sentences: 今天讨论的是家庭小白如何在家里做出一份适合拉花的浓缩咖啡。
Today we're talking about how a home beginner pulls an espresso that's good for latte art.
pull an espresso（萃取浓缩）
这杯浓缩好不好喝，不在我们今天的讨论范围之内。
Whether it tastes amazing — that's out of scope today.
out of scope（不在范围内）
这个问题依然是分成三步：选豆、设备、参数。
It still comes down to three steps: the beans, the gear, and the parameters.
the beans, the gear, the parameters（选豆/设备/参数）
paraphrase: We're not here to judge the flavor today.
scenes.speak: Today we're talking about how a home beginner pulls an espresso that's good for latte art. Whether it tastes amazing — that's out of scope today. It still comes down to three steps: the beans, the gear, and the parameters.

scenes.title_cn: 选豆：传统拼配与中深烘焙
scenes.title_en: Choosing Beans: Traditional Blend, Medium-Dark Roast
scenes.context: 咖啡豆分意式与手冲；意式又含传统拼配与SOE。拉花要选传统拼配——关键词是「意式咖啡、中深烘焙」，手冲与SOE尽量不选。豆类互转理论上自由，但建议按品牌建议做对应咖啡。
sentences: 常见的有意式或者手冲这两款咖啡豆。
There are two common kinds of beans: espresso and pour-over.
espresso beans（意式咖啡豆）
我们要做一杯适合拉花的浓缩，要选择的是传统拼配。
For a latte-art espresso, you want a traditional blend.
traditional blend（传统拼配）
理论上你想怎么做就怎么做，但建议按照品牌建议去做。
In theory you can do whatever you like, but it's best to follow the roaster's suggestion.
follow the roaster's suggestion（按品牌建议）
paraphrase: Scan the bag for the right labels.
Trust what the roaster recommends on the bag.
scenes.speak: There are two common kinds of beans: espresso and pour-over. For a latte-art espresso, you want a traditional blend. In theory you can do whatever you like, but it's best to follow the roaster's suggestion.

scenes.context: 选 1-3 个月内新鲜烘焙的豆子才有丰富油脂；保存禁止与空气长时间接触，用不完放回原包装；豆子不能太新鲜，养十天半个月再使用，太新鲜萃取冒大泡不利拉花。
sentences: 我们会选择新鲜烘焙一到三个月以内的咖啡豆。
We pick beans roasted within the last one to three months.
roasted within 1-3 months（一到三个月内烘焙）
禁止与空气进行长时间的接触。
Never let them sit in contact with air for long.
in contact with air（与空气接触）
豆子最好养个十天半个月再去使用。
It's best to rest the beans for a week or two before using them.
rest the beans（养豆）
paraphrase: Fresher beans give you that rich crema.
Overly fresh beans bubble up big and hard — bad for art.
scenes.speak: We pick beans roasted within the last one to three months. Never let them sit in contact with air for long. It's best to rest the beans for a week or two before using them.

scenes.title_cn: 设备与研磨：专业机、电磨、看流速
scenes.title_en: Gear and Grind: Real Machines, Read the Flow
scenes.context: 设备必须是专业咖啡机（禁玩具机）+ 专业电磨（手摇太累）。研磨度不看刻度看流速三态：像水说明粗了往细调，点滴不出液说明细了往粗调，像油流下就 OK。调整永远结果导向。
sentences: 设备只有一个要求：它得是专业的咖啡机。
The gear has one rule: it has to be a real espresso machine.
a real espresso machine（专业的咖啡机）
刻度其实没有太重要，重要的在于你的流速。
The grind number doesn't matter much — what matters is the flow.
the flow（流速）
意式咖啡的调整永远都是结果导向的。
Adjusting espresso is always result-driven.
result-driven（结果导向）
paraphrase: Let the pour tell you which way to turn the grinder.
Toy machines are a dead end for espresso.
scenes.speak: The gear has one rule: it has to be a real espresso machine. The grind number doesn't matter much — what matters is the flow. Adjusting espresso is always result-driven.

scenes.context: 推荐参数：18.5-20克粉、88-90度水温、23-30秒、液重比 1:1.5-1.7。想更适配拉花可增粉量或降液重，浓缩更丝滑有支撑力，但不一定更好喝。
sentences: 我们建议给到 18.5 到 20 克的粉。
We suggest dosing 18.5 to 20 grams of grounds.
dosing（布粉量）
液重比我们推荐给到 1 比 1.5 到 1.7 之间。
We recommend a yield ratio of 1:1.5 to 1.7.
yield ratio（液重比）
增加粉量、降低液重，会更丝滑更有支撑力，但不一定更好喝。
More coffee or less yield makes it silkier and more structured — but not necessarily tastier.
silkier（更丝滑）
paraphrase: A thicker shot holds the art better.
It's a trade-off: structure over flavor.
scenes.speak: We suggest dosing 18.5 to 20 grams of grounds. We recommend a yield ratio of 1:1.5 to 1.7. More coffee or less yield makes it silkier and more structured — but not necessarily tastier.

practice.q: 「萃取一杯适合拉花的浓缩」怎么说？
practice.a: Pull an espresso that's good for latte art.

practice.q: 「选传统拼配、中深烘焙」怎么表达？
practice.a: Go with a traditional blend, medium-dark roasted.

practice.q: 「研磨度看流速不看刻度」怎么说？
practice.a: Read the flow, not the grind number.

practice.q: 「液重比 1:1.5 更丝滑有支撑力」怎么讲？
practice.a: A 1:1.5 yield makes the shot silkier and more structured.

pitfalls: Ask if grind setting 3 is fine.
Adjust by reading the flow instead.
Grind numbers vary by grinder and burr spacing, so they're meaningless across machines.
Rest the beans for one to two weeks first.
Too-fresh beans bubble up big and hard, which wrecks latte art.
Buy a cheap all-in-one espresso machine.
Get a real espresso machine from a proper brand.
Espresso has a real bar; toy machines can't hold the parameters.
Always aim for a 1:2 yield like the classic recipe.
A shorter, thicker shot has more structure and holds the art better.
shifts: 凭刻度数字调研磨，照着1:2经典比例
看流速三态反推研磨，按1:1.5-1.7适配拉花
difficult_words: Pull an espresso that's good for latte art.
Whether it tastes amazing is out of scope.
Two common kinds: espresso and pour-over.
Roasted within one to three months.
Never let them sit in contact with air.
Rest the beans for a week or two.
Fresher beans give you rich crema.
Toy machines are a dead end.
It's a trade-off: structure over flavor.
